firm_data.firm_description: Berry Appleman & Leiden LLP (BAL) is a global corporate immigration law firm serving U.S. and global companies around the world. Since 1980, the firm has delivered consistently excellent service across their legal teams.
notable_facts: Top-ranked in Chambers Global Guide for seven years running (as of 2021)
Has a Silicon Valley campus in Santa Clara, CA
technology_signals: Proprietary Cobalt® mobile app and artificial intelligent engines
Leveraging AI, machine learning and robotic process automation (RPA)

ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm uses "artificial intelligent engines" and has leveraged and developed AI, machine learning and robotic process automation (RPA).

email.subject: AI for Berry Appleman & Leiden LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jeremy,

BAL's investment in proprietary Cobalt mobile app and artificial intelligent engines puts you ahead of most immigration practices. You're clearly committed to leveraging AI and machine learning to compete on scale and precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Dallas to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping corporate immigration practices compete with BigLaw on throughput without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
